label: Reporting period length
definition_plain: How many months the report covers. Almost always 12.

label: Annualisation factor
definition_plain: What to multiply a yearly total by to make a non-12-month year comparable with a normal year.

label: Turnover
definition_plain: Revenue from operations in rupees, after the scale corrections.

label: Turnover (Rs crore)
definition_plain: The same turnover in rupees crore; the denominator of every intensity.

label: Total workforce
definition_plain: Everyone working for the company: employees and workers, permanent and other than permanent.

label: Women in the workforce
definition_plain: The number of women among employees and workers.

label: Women in workforce (%)
definition_plain: Out of every 100 people working for the company, how many are women.

label: Women share of gross wages (%)
definition_plain: Out of every 100 rupees of wages the company pays, how many go to women.

label: Pay equity gap (pp)
definition_plain: Women's share of wages minus women's share of the workforce. Negative means women get a smaller slice of the pay than of the headcount.

label: Women on the board (%)
definition_plain: The share of board directors who are women.

label: Attrition, women (%)
definition_plain: The share of permanent female employees who left during the year.

label: Attrition, men (%)
definition_plain: The share of permanent male employees who left during the year.

label: Attrition gap (pp)
definition_plain: How much faster women leave than men. Positive means women leave more often.

label: Scope 1 emissions
definition_plain: Greenhouse gases from sources the company owns or controls (fuel burnt, process emissions).

label: Scope 2 emissions
definition_plain: Greenhouse gases from the electricity, heat and steam the company buys.

label: Scope 1+2 emissions
definition_plain: The company's own emissions plus those of the energy it buys.

label: Scope 3 emissions
definition_plain: Emissions in the value chain (suppliers, product use). Voluntary, so often missing.

label: GHG intensity (Scope 1+2 per Rs crore)
definition_plain: Tonnes of greenhouse gas for every Rs 1 crore of revenue. Lets a big and a small company be compared.

label: GHG intensity as filed
formula_text: filed value read as per rupee, x 1e7
definition_plain: The intensity the company itself reported. A cross-check only: companies use different denominators.

label: GHG intensity: filed / computed
definition_plain: How far the company's own intensity is from ours. 1 means it agrees; 10,000,000 means it divided by crore instead of rupees.

label: Total energy
definition_plain: All the energy the company used in the year.

label: Renewable energy
definition_plain: The part of that energy that came from renewable sources.

label: Renewable share of energy (%)
definition_plain: Out of all the energy used, the percentage from solar, wind, hydro and other renewables.

label: Energy intensity (GJ per Rs crore)
definition_plain: Energy used for every Rs 1 crore of revenue.

label: Energy intensity as filed
formula_text: filed value read as per rupee, x 1e7
definition_plain: The energy intensity the company itself reported. A cross-check only.

label: Energy intensity: filed / computed
definition_plain: How far the company's own energy intensity is from ours.

label: Water withdrawal
definition_plain: All the water the company took from any source.

label: Water consumption
definition_plain: Water taken and not returned (withdrawal minus discharge).

label: Water intensity (kl per Rs crore)
definition_plain: Water consumed for every Rs 1 crore of revenue.

label: Water intensity as filed
formula_text: filed value read as per rupee, x 1e7
definition_plain: The water intensity the company itself reported. A cross-check only.

label: Water intensity: filed / computed
definition_plain: How far the company's own water intensity is from ours.

label: Waste generated
definition_plain: All the waste the company produced.

label: Waste recovered
definition_plain: Waste recycled, re-used or otherwise recovered.

label: Waste disposed
definition_plain: Waste burnt, landfilled or otherwise disposed of.

label: Waste recovery rate (%)
definition_plain: Out of all the waste produced, the percentage recovered instead of dumped. Above 100 means old stock was recovered too.

label: Waste intensity (t per Rs crore)
definition_plain: Tonnes of waste for every Rs 1 crore of revenue.

label: Waste balance gap (%)
definition_plain: A consistency check: the share of waste that is neither recovered nor disposed in the filing. Far from 0 means the figures do not add up.

label: LTIFR, employees
definition_plain: Injuries that cost working time, per one million hours worked by employees.

label: LTIFR, workers
definition_plain: Injuries that cost working time, per one million hours worked by workers.

label: Recordable injuries
definition_plain: All work injuries that had to be recorded, employees and workers together.

label: Fatalities
definition_plain: Work-related deaths, employees and workers together.

label: Fatalities per 10,000 workforce
definition_plain: Work-related deaths for every 10,000 people working for the company.

label: POSH complaints (% of female staff)
definition_plain: Sexual-harassment complaints as a share of female staff. Not ranked: a higher figure can mean more incidents or more trust in the reporting channel.

label: POSH complaints upheld
definition_plain: How many of those complaints were upheld.

label: Well-being spend (% of revenue)
definition_plain: What the company spends on employee well-being measures, as a share of its revenue.

label: Sourcing from MSMEs (%)
definition_plain: The share of input material bought directly from small businesses and small producers.

label: Days of accounts payable
definition_plain: How many days, on average, the company takes to pay its suppliers.

label: Purchases from related parties (%)
definition_plain: The share of purchases made from companies related to the owners or management.

label: Sales to related parties (%)
definition_plain: The share of sales made to companies related to the owners or management.

label: Values replaced (scale errors)
definition_plain: How many of the company-year's filed numbers were replaced by the figure from the next report because they were more than 100 times apart.

label: Scope 1 emissions (annualised)
formula_text: ghg_s1_tco2e x annualisation_factor, only if period_months != 12
definition_plain: The same figure scaled to 12 months, filled only when the report covers a different period.

label: Scope 2 emissions (annualised)
formula_text: ghg_s2_tco2e x annualisation_factor, only if period_months != 12
definition_plain: The same figure scaled to 12 months, filled only when the report covers a different period.

label: Scope 1+2 emissions (annualised)
formula_text: ghg_s12_tco2e x annualisation_factor, only if period_months != 12
definition_plain: The same figure scaled to 12 months, filled only when the report covers a different period.

label: Scope 3 emissions (annualised)
formula_text: ghg_s3_tco2e x annualisation_factor, only if period_months != 12
definition_plain: The same figure scaled to 12 months, filled only when the report covers a different period.

label: Total energy (annualised)
formula_text: energy_total_gj x annualisation_factor, only if period_months != 12
definition_plain: The same figure scaled to 12 months, filled only when the report covers a different period.

label: Renewable energy (annualised)
formula_text: energy_renewable_gj x annualisation_factor, only if period_months != 12
definition_plain: The same figure scaled to 12 months, filled only when the report covers a different period.

label: Water withdrawal (annualised)
formula_text: water_withdrawal_kl x annualisation_factor, only if period_months != 12
definition_plain: The same figure scaled to 12 months, filled only when the report covers a different period.

label: Water consumption (annualised)
formula_text: water_consumption_kl x annualisation_factor, only if period_months != 12
definition_plain: The same figure scaled to 12 months, filled only when the report covers a different period.

label: Waste generated (annualised)
formula_text: waste_generated_t x annualisation_factor, only if period_months != 12
definition_plain: The same figure scaled to 12 months, filled only when the report covers a different period.

label: Waste recovered (annualised)
formula_text: waste_recovered_t x annualisation_factor, only if period_months != 12
definition_plain: The same figure scaled to 12 months, filled only when the report covers a different period.

label: Waste disposed (annualised)
formula_text: waste_disposed_t x annualisation_factor, only if period_months != 12
definition_plain: The same figure scaled to 12 months, filled only when the report covers a different period.

label: Turnover (annualised)
formula_text: turnover_inr x annualisation_factor, only if period_months != 12
definition_plain: The same figure scaled to 12 months, filled only when the report covers a different period.

label: Disclosure Quality Score
formula_text: weighted average of the scored components x 100; weights re-normalised over them
denominator: sum of the weights of the scored components
definition_plain: How complete, consistent and assured the company's disclosure is, from 0 to 100. It is not an ESG rating: a heavy emitter that reports carefully scores high.

label: DQS: completeness
definition_plain: Half of it is whether the company filed what it had to; the other half is how many of the voluntary (Leadership) indicators it also answered.

label: DQS: mandatory completeness
definition_plain: Out of the metrics the company had to file that year, the share it did file. A filed 'not applicable' counts as filed.

label: DQS: voluntary depth
formula_text: Leadership indicators with a substantive value / Leadership indicators in the taxonomy of the filing
numerator: Leadership indicators with a substantive value
definition_plain: Out of the voluntary (Leadership) indicators of the report, the share the company answered with a number or a real text. 'NA', 'Not applicable' and 'Nil' do not count.

label: DQS: internal consistency
definition_plain: The share of the checks inside one filing that pass: waste figures add up, waste recovered is not more than waste generated, no implausible zero, no unit or scale we had to correct.

label: DQS: temporal consistency
formula_text: 1 - flagged metrics / comparable metrics; empty if no later filing
definition_plain: The share of metrics that hold up when checked against the company's next report: no scale error, no material restatement, no unexplained jump. Empty for the latest year.

label: DQS: assurance
formula_text: baseline points of the assurance level + whole-report bonus, at most 1 (seed dqs_assurance_points)
definition_plain: Reasonable assurance on the BRSR Core is required by SEBI, so it earns 0.5. Assurance of the whole report adds 0.5. A third-party assessment earns 0.4, limited assurance 0.3, none 0. Empty before FY2023-24.

label: DQS: components scored
definition_plain: How many of the four components could be scored for the company-year. A grade and a rank need at least three.

label: DQS: companies ranked in the group
formula_text: count of companies with a gradable score in the ranking group and year
definition_plain: How many companies of the ranking group have a gradable score that year. No rank is given below 5.

label: DQS: rank in ranking group
formula_text: rank of dqs_total within ranking group and year (1 = best); only if at least 5 companies
definition_plain: The company's place in its ranking group that year, 1 being the best score. Ties share the better place.

label: DQS: percentile in ranking group
formula_text: percent rank of dqs_total within ranking group and year x 100; only if at least 5 companies
definition_plain: Where the company stands in its ranking group that year: 100 is the best score, 0 the lowest.

label: GHG intensity, whole group
formula_text: sum(ghg_s12_tco2e) / sum(turnover_cr) over the companies that have both
definition_plain: All the Scope 1+2 emissions of the group divided by all its turnover: the intensity of the group as if it were one company. Large companies weigh more.

label: GHG intensity, typical company
definition_plain: The intensity of the company in the middle of the group: half the companies are below it, half above. Every company weighs the same.

label: Companies with a ghg intensity
formula_text: count of distinct companies with ghg_intensity_tco2e_per_cr
definition_plain: How many companies of the group have a ghg intensity. The whole-group and typical-company figures may be published only when this is 5 or more.

label: Energy intensity, whole group
formula_text: sum(energy_total_gj) / sum(turnover_cr) over the companies that have both
definition_plain: All the energy used of the group divided by all its turnover: the intensity of the group as if it were one company. Large companies weigh more.

label: Energy intensity, typical company
definition_plain: The intensity of the company in the middle of the group: half the companies are below it, half above. Every company weighs the same.

label: Companies with a energy intensity
formula_text: count of distinct companies with energy_intensity_gj_per_cr
definition_plain: How many companies of the group have a energy intensity. The whole-group and typical-company figures may be published only when this is 5 or more.

label: Water intensity, whole group
formula_text: sum(water_consumption_kl) / sum(turnover_cr) over the companies that have both
definition_plain: All the water consumed of the group divided by all its turnover: the intensity of the group as if it were one company. Large companies weigh more.

label: Water intensity, typical company
definition_plain: The intensity of the company in the middle of the group: half the companies are below it, half above. Every company weighs the same.

label: Companies with a water intensity
formula_text: count of distinct companies with water_intensity_kl_per_cr
definition_plain: How many companies of the group have a water intensity. The whole-group and typical-company figures may be published only when this is 5 or more.

label: Waste intensity, whole group
formula_text: sum(waste_generated_t) / sum(turnover_cr) over the companies that have both
definition_plain: All the waste generated of the group divided by all its turnover: the intensity of the group as if it were one company. Large companies weigh more.

label: Waste intensity, typical company
definition_plain: The intensity of the company in the middle of the group: half the companies are below it, half above. Every company weighs the same.

label: Companies with a waste intensity
formula_text: count of distinct companies with waste_intensity_t_per_cr
definition_plain: How many companies of the group have a waste intensity. The whole-group and typical-company figures may be published only when this is 5 or more.

label: Renewable share of energy, whole group (%)
formula_text: sum(energy_renewable_gj) / sum(energy_total_gj) x 100 over the companies that have both
definition_plain: Out of all the energy the group used, the percentage that was renewable. Large energy users weigh more.

label: Companies with a renewable share
formula_text: count of distinct companies with renewable_share_pct
definition_plain: How many companies of the group have a renewable share. The whole-group figure may be published only when this is 5 or more.

label: Women in workforce, whole group (%)
formula_text: sum(headcount_female) / sum(headcount_total) x 100 over the companies that have both
definition_plain: Out of everyone working for the companies of the group, the percentage who are women. Large employers weigh more.

label: Companies with a women-in-workforce share
formula_text: count of distinct companies with female_workforce_pct
definition_plain: How many companies of the group have a women-in-workforce share. The whole-group figure may be published only when this is 5 or more.

label: Companies reporting
formula_text: count of distinct companies with a filing
definition_plain: How many companies have a report in the group and year.

label: Companies disclosing Scope 3 (%)
formula_text: company-years with a Scope 3 value / company-years x 100
definition_plain: Out of every 100 company reports, how many give a Scope 3 emissions figure.

label: Disclosure Quality Score, average
definition_plain: The average Disclosure Quality Score of the group. Compare within one financial year only.

label: Disclosure Quality Score, typical company
definition_plain: The Disclosure Quality Score of the company in the middle of the group.

label: Company-years graded A (%)
formula_text: company-years with grade A / company-years with a grade x 100
definition_plain: Out of every 100 graded company reports, how many reach grade A (85 points or more).

label: Voluntary depth, average
definition_plain: On average, the share of the voluntary (Leadership) indicators that the companies of the group answered.

label: Companies with a Disclosure Quality Score
formula_text: count of distinct companies with dqs_total
definition_plain: How many companies of the group have a Disclosure Quality Score.

label: Companies with a Disclosure Quality grade
formula_text: count of distinct companies with a grade A to D
definition_plain: How many companies of the group have a grade (at least three components scored).

label: Companies with a voluntary depth
formula_text: count of distinct companies with dqs_voluntary_depth
definition_plain: How many companies of the group have a voluntary depth figure.

label: Material restatements
formula_text: count of compared pairs classified material
definition_plain: How many figures were changed materially in the next year's report. A restatement is not wrongdoing.

label: Figures materially restated (%)
formula_text: compared pairs classified material / compared pairs x 100
definition_plain: Out of every 100 figures that could be compared with the next year's report, how many were changed materially.

label: Suspected scale errors
definition_plain: How many figures are more than 100 times apart from the next year's report: unit slips, not restatements.

label: Companies with compared figures
formula_text: count of distinct companies with a compared pair
definition_plain: How many companies of the group have at least one figure that could be compared with the next year's report.

label: Rank by Scope 1+2 emissions
formula_text: rank of ghg_s12_tco2e within the year, largest = 1
definition_plain: Where the company stands among all companies covered that year by the size of its Scope 1+2 emissions: 1 is the largest emitter.

label: Companies with Scope 1+2 emissions that year
formula_text: count of companies with ghg_s12_tco2e in the year
definition_plain: How many companies the ranking and the shares of that year are built from.

label: Share of the emissions of all companies covered (%)
formula_text: ghg_s12_tco2e / sum of ghg_s12_tco2e of the year x 100
denominator: sum of ghg_s12_tco2e of the year
definition_plain: Out of every 100 tonnes of Scope 1+2 emissions of all companies covered that year, how many come from this company. The tonnes and the total are not published.

label: Cumulative share of emissions (%)
formula_text: running sum of share_of_total_pct from the largest emitter down
denominator: sum of ghg_s12_tco2e of the year
definition_plain: The share held by this company and every larger emitter together: the line of a Pareto chart.

label: Percentile in the ranking group
formula_text: percent rank within ranking group, year and KPI x 100 (100 = best)
definition_plain: Share of the other companies of the group that do worse on this KPI. Only with 5 or more companies with a value and a material KPI.

label: Rank in the ranking group
formula_text: rank within ranking group, year and KPI (1 = best; ties share the better rank)
definition_plain: The company's place in its ranking group on this KPI: 1 is the best. Only where a percentile is given.

label: Companies in the group with a value
formula_text: count of companies of the ranking group with a rankable value of the KPI that year
definition_plain: How many companies the rank and the percentile are built from. Below 5 there is no rank.

label: KPI value (public KPIs only)
formula_text: the KPI value when kpi_catalogue marks the KPI public_safe; empty otherwise
definition_plain: The company's own value of the KPI, shown only for values ESG Lens India computes (such as intensities). Filed values stay empty.

label: GHG intensity in the earlier year
formula_text: ghg_s12_tco2e / turnover_cr of the earlier year, computed by ESG Lens India
definition_plain: The company's Scope 1+2 emissions per Rs crore of turnover in the first year of the pair.

label: GHG intensity in the later year
formula_text: ghg_s12_tco2e / turnover_cr of the later year, computed by ESG Lens India
definition_plain: The company's Scope 1+2 emissions per Rs crore of turnover in the second year of the pair.

label: Year-on-year change of GHG intensity (%)
definition_plain: How much the intensity moved from one year to the next. Only confirmed changes are ranked.

label: Comparable companies in the group that year
formula_text: count of pairs in the ranking group ending in the same year
definition_plain: How many companies of the ranking group have a comparable pair ending that year. A ranking needs 5.

label: Improvement rank in the group
formula_text: rank of change_pct ascending within the ranking group, confirmed pairs only
definition_plain: 1 = the largest confirmed improvement in the ranking group.

label: Deterioration rank in the group
formula_text: rank of change_pct descending within the ranking group, confirmed pairs only
definition_plain: 1 = the largest confirmed deterioration in the ranking group.

label: Improvement rank overall
formula_text: row number of change_pct ascending over all confirmed pairs
definition_plain: 1 = the largest confirmed improvement of all ranked pairs.

label: Deterioration rank overall
formula_text: row number of change_pct descending over all confirmed pairs
definition_plain: 1 = the largest confirmed deterioration of all ranked pairs.
